classes.name: VisibilityAwarePaginationModule
classes.description: Private in-process module that scans storage rows in bounded batches, filters caller-visible rows, applies offset and limit to visible rows, and fails closed when the scan budget is exhausted.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, enforces tenant and team-namespace admission, and maps protocol messages and errors around domain modules.

classes.name: VisibilityFilteredDecisionListing
classes.description: Decision listing whose page includes only rows readable by the authenticated caller, without exposing whether hidden rows exist.

classes.name: VisibilityFilteredAttestationListing
classes.description: Attestation listing whose offset and limit count only policy scopes administered by the authenticated caller.

relations.name: delegates_visibility_pagination_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates bounded post-fetch visibility pagination to one shared module.

relations.name: paginates_visible_decisions
relations.description: The shared pagination module applies bounded visibility-aware pagination to decision listings.

relations.name: paginates_visible_attestations
relations.description: The shared pagination module applies bounded visibility-aware pagination to attestation listings.
